_comment: Species templates for known civilisations plus procedural biome life pools used by PlanetGenerator.

templates.name: Terran Human
templates.notes: Survived its own technological adolescence by roughly one generation's margin.

templates.name: Vherrathi
templates.notes: A Vherrathi never forgets a slight, because forgetting is how the Sundering happened.

templates.name: Kelthari
templates.biology: Colonial gas-filled floaters; individuals are short-lived organs of a continuous organism
templates.homeworld: The Outer Reef (gas giant, Outer Disk)
templates.notes: Individual death is unremarkable to them. The death of a song is a tragedy.

templates.name: Remnant Clans
templates.biology: Heterogeneous human and near-human stock; heavy clan endogamy
templates.notes: Not one people but a marketplace of peoples with a shared grudge.

terrestrial.name: Spiregrass
terrestrial.desc: Silica-reinforced blades that ring in the wind like cut glass.

terrestrial.name: Lumenpods
terrestrial.desc: Seed casings that glow faintly when the local star is high.

terrestrial.name: Grazer-herd
terrestrial.desc: Low-slung hexapods that migrate along thermal seams.

terrestrial.name: Bark-eels
terrestrial.desc: Arboreal ambush predators. Do not stand under trees.

ocean.name: Raft-forests
ocean.desc: Floating mats kilometres wide, alive with trapped gas.

ocean.name: Abyssal lanterns
ocean.desc: Pressure-adapted filter feeders that farm their own light.

ocean.name: Tidewraiths
ocean.desc: Pack hunters that ride the thermocline. Curious about ships.

desert.name: Stone-bloom
desert.desc: A cactus-analogue that flowers for eleven minutes per decade.

desert.name: Dune skippers
desert.desc: Heat-gliding reptiles that burrow to escape the noon.

desert.name: Glasswyrms
desert.desc: Subsurface tunnellers. Their passages collapse under vehicle weight.

ice.name: Cryomoss
ice.desc: A red-black lichen that metabolises at 40 Kelvin.

ice.name: Vent swarms
ice.desc: Blind filter feeders clustered around hydrothermal vents.

ice.name: Frost-leviathans
ice.desc: Enormous, slow, and entirely uninterested in you, until they are not.

volcanic.name: Slag-ferns
volcanic.desc: Iron-leafed plants that grow only where the crust is thin.

volcanic.name: Cinder-stalkers
volcanic.desc: Predators that hunt by infrared silhouette. Highly territorial.

toxic.name: Sulphur veils
toxic.desc: Translucent sheets that metabolise atmospheric acid.

toxic.name: Chrome beetles
toxic.desc: Metal-shelled detritivores the size of a fist.

toxic.name: Haze-angels
toxic.desc: Floating drifters that sift toxin for trace metals.

gasGiant.name: Drift-meadows
gasGiant.desc: Aeroplankton continents drifting in the upper atmosphere.

gasGiant.name: Storm-whales
gasGiant.desc: Kilometre-long filter drifters that ride the jet streams.

tidallyLocked.name: Twilight-bands
tidallyLocked.desc: Everything lives in the thin ring of permanent dusk.

tidallyLocked.name: Terminus herds
tidallyLocked.desc: Migratory grazers that follow the terminator line.

tidallyLocked.name: Night-things
tidallyLocked.desc: Whatever evolved on the dark side. It is not friendly and it is not stupid.
